trans-unit.source: Everybody will be leaving if we defeat Dhaos...
trans-unit.target: Everybody will be leaving if we defeat Dhaos...

trans-unit.source: It will be quite lonely, yes?
trans-unit.target: It will be quite lonely, yes?

trans-unit.source: If nothing bad happens, I'm sure I'll meet you again. So be patient, 'kay?
trans-unit.target: If nothing bad happens, I'm sure I'll meet you again. So be patient, 'kay?

trans-unit.source: But half-elves are not permitted into Ymir Forest...
trans-unit.target: But half-elves are not permitted into Ymir Forest...

trans-unit.source: <wait_A0>I'll just fly over it and dive straight into your house if I have to.
trans-unit.target: <wait_A0>I'll just fly over it and dive straight into your house if I have to.

trans-unit.source: Then I shall be waiting for you.
trans-unit.target: Then I shall be waiting for you.
